name: Garden Retail Research Specialist
tagline: Monday intel for vendors serving garden-centre retailers, with supplier leads
description: Competitive research for wholesale vendors whose customers are independent garden centers. Each Monday it surveys category movement, what retailers plan to shelve next season, and which new tools or merchandise are earning shelf space, then passes along supplier contacts worth a call.
author: dltelford
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
